name: Bubba Brown
strengths: Brown creates separation with sudden releases and sharp breaks.
Brown is sudden after the catch and turns short throws into chunk plays.
Brown contests catches and finishes through contact for a 190-pound frame.
weaknesses: Brown still needs consistency as a vertical separator versus length corners who can match his stride.
comparison: Brown comps to Chris Olave — 6-1 polished perimeter WR with suddenness after the catch and reliable separation habits.
projection: Brown projects as a Year 2 SEC starter on the perimeter (package snaps Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC WR — the polished separator who wins with routes and YAC violence after the catch.
schemeFit: Brown fits Faulkner RPO / rhythm offense as a perimeter WR who separates and creates after the catch.
